description: Java class defining a command for requesting pages from a subscription of search results, including JSON serialization/deserialization, and related metadata.

classes.name: RequestFromSubscription
classes.description: Immutable command class for requesting pages from a subscription, with JSON serialization support.

classes.name: RequestFromSubscription.JsonFields
classes.description: Contains JSON field definitions for the command.

methods.name: RequestFromSubscription.of
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the command with specified subscription ID, demand, and headers.

methods.name: RequestFromSubscription.fromJson
methods.description: Deserializes a JSON object into a RequestFromSubscription instance.

methods.name: getSubscriptionId
methods.description: Returns the subscription ID associated with the request.

methods.name: getDemand
methods.description: Returns the demand (number of pages requested).

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Appends command data to JSON payload for serialization.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category of the command (QUERY).

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with updated DittoHeaders.
